products.title: Lattices
products.description: Windows, workspaces, terminal sessions, and voice input.

agent.expect: The daemon method list. Then read `lats call desktop.snapshot` before you move any window.
agent.boundary: Lattices owns windows, tiling, spaces, workspace layers, tmux sessions, screen text, and voice input. Native app control is Action; notes are Canvas; spoken output is Speech.

products.title: Action
products.description: Observe and control apps, browsers, and recordings.

agent.expect: Install, runtime, and agent state. Over MCP, read `capabilities` and `tools/list` and report the native/runtime match before you take control.
agent.boundary: Action owns native observe, resolve, act, and record, private agent layers, and Action-owned browsers. Window tiling and workspaces are Lattices.

products.title: Canvas
products.description: Spatial notes, placement, and named desks.

agent.expect: The note list as JSON. Set `BLINK_HOME` to a scratch directory for automation that must not touch the user's notes.
agent.boundary: Canvas owns spatial notes: one Markdown file per floating panel, placement, and named desks. It does not control other windows or speak.

products.title: Speech
products.description: Queue text, choose voices, and control playback.

agent.expect: A `helper` section with the Voice.app queue, or an error code with a recovery step. This check makes no sound.
agent.boundary: Speech owns spoken output: the queue, voices, and playback. Listening and spoken commands are Lattices voice input.
